claims.value: Toreno gives side B 12,000 appearing on La Bisbal’s heights on 26 September for the relief operation.
claims.rationale: Blake’s relief-army population, not all convoy escorts simultaneously engaged or a garrison reinforcement actually admitted. English rendering (ours): "He appeared on 26 September with twelve thousand men on the La Bisbal heights, two leagues from Gerona."

claims.value: Saint-Cyr identifies a supporting French-side subset of three battalions and a squadron previously at La Bisbal, not the full French force.
claims.rationale: Formation counts only; no conversion into soldiers or sum of overlapping contingents. English rendering (ours): "The three battalions and squadron previously at La Bisbal, which Fontane had brought from Salt."

claims.value: Toreno puts Blake with the main army on the heights, O’Donnell over the vanguard and Wimpffen with the convoy.
claims.rationale: The paragraph places Blake over the main body. Field/escort tasks do not confer equal commander credit. English rendering (ours): "Wimpffen followed O’Donnell with the convoy."

citations.locator: toreno-t3, printed p. 111, Internet Archive leaf 116; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Seguia á Odonnell Wimpffen con el convoy

claims.value: Saint-Cyr describes the chief ordering the columns allowed through until the lead was close to Gerona, then attacked.
claims.rationale: Interested account of his own planned interception; Mazuchelli/Pino/Fontane tasks are subordinate. English rendering (ours): "The chief ordered the columns allowed through and attacked only when the first was near Gerona."

citations.locator: saint-cyr, printed p. 258, Internet Archive leaf 262; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: le général en chef ordonna de laisser passer ses colonnes, et de ne les attaquer que quand la première serait près d’arriver à Gironne

claims.value: Saint-Cyr describes a Spanish main relief attack followed by a planned French interception of the convoy.
claims.rationale: Main relief offensive and deliberate French interception are distinct operations within the frozen entry. Exact engagement boundary is unresolved; no campaign/siege double credit. English rendering (ours): "On the 26th the first Spanish column arrived before daylight behind Mazuchelli and attacked the seventh-regiment battalion; the chief ordered the columns attacked near Gerona."

claims.value: Toreno says Blake’s objective was again to provision the besieged place.
claims.rationale: Source-stated relief objective, not a measured campaign contribution. English rendering (ours): "He again attempted to provision the place."

claims.value: Toreno says the convoy was captured except loads brought into Gerona.
claims.rationale: Post-action supply result. This observation is not added again as an independent siege victory. English rendering (ours): "He captured it all except some 170 loads that were saved and brought into Gerona."
